summary.zh: 挑技术栈、搭项目骨架并给代码打分
summary.en: Pick a stack, scaffold the app and score code quality

description.zh: 在 Next.js、FastAPI、MERN、Django 之间做选型，然后把项目骨架搭起来，并对现有代码库做质量评分。适合新项目开工，或想弄清一个已有仓库有多乱、从哪开始收拾时使用。
description.en: Chooses among Next.js, FastAPI, MERN and Django, scaffolds the project, and scores an existing codebase's quality. Use it to start a new web app or to find out how messy a repository is and where to begin.
